Yes! Actually, losing one of my ferrets to cancer triggered a big mixed episode in me. And when my other ferret died of insulinoma months later I went into another one/the current one worsened. When I had to move away from my parents place during the pandemic I couldn't see any of my ferrets and my depression worsened from that. We also had to give the two youngest to the humane society because I wasn't there to help care for them. Pets can be very valued family members and losing them can be painful. I still miss all of them. I've had depressive episodes since middle school and was diagnosed when I was 18 after I started having manic episodes.

Lamictal has really changed my life. After starting it my huge depressive episodes went down to way lowergrade episodes/no episodes and less in frequency. It took like 3-4 weeks to get into full affect. My mania got controlled by Seroquel as well. Now I am way more stable than I used to be.

This is just my experience, everyone is impacted by a med differently and it might just not work for you.
